threads.body:
@copilot Simplify the baseline test fixtures in this PR directly, preserving all existing coverage and behavior. Do not create a separate pull request.

In instrumentation/spring/spring-integration-4.1/testing/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/spring/integration/v4_1/AbstractSpringIntegration41Test.java and javaagent/src/version41Test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/spring/integration/v4_1/SpringIntegrationAmqp41Test.java, reuse the existing shared CapturingMessageHandler in the basic propagation and AMQP tests instead of repeating lambdas that capture a message and create a "handler" span. Keep the telemetry and message assertions equivalent. Do not use that helper where its extra handler span would change a test's intended behavior.

In shouldCleanUpAfterFailedSend, use assertThatThrownBy directly instead of catchThrowable plus a temporary Throwable. In shouldRestoreOuterContextAfterNestedSend, assertThat(Context.current()).isSameAs(before) instead of comparing the two contexts' span contexts, matching the other restoration assertions.

Flatten SpringIntegrationAmqp41Test's nested resource-cleanup blocks with the repository's AutoCleanupExtension pattern. Register cleanup as each resource is created, ensure partially initialized resources are cleaned up if setup fails, and preserve correct shutdown order. Avoid introducing a custom cleanup abstraction.

Keep the isolated version41Test suites in both modules and their original Spring Integration 4.1 runtime dependencies, automatic agent versus explicit library registration, span and metric assertions, AMQP handoff with and without lower Rabbit processing, and existing newer-stack coverage. Keep both executor tests distinct: Integration 4.1 ExecutorChannel exercises send-time fallback, while Framework ExecutorSubscribableChannel exercises handler callbacks and reused worker-thread cleanup. Do not merge them, remove their lifecycle assertions, broaden this into a refactor of the older Boot-based test hierarchy, or change production behavior. Make only these targeted fixture simplifications and remove imports made unused by them.

Run the narrow formatting tasks and both modules' version41Test suites when feasible. Verify behavior rather than merely reducing line count, and report concrete validation limitations honestly. Preserve this PR's current draft state and base branch.

replies.body: Implemented the fixture simplifications in `cfaea790`. Both `version41Test` suites and targeted Spotless checks pass. I retained the span-context assertion for the nested send: in javaagent mode `AgentContextStorage.current()` constructs a fresh `AgentContextWrapper` on each call, so `isSameAs(before)` fails despite correct restoration. The other restoration identity assertions remain unchanged.
